jobs.description_text: Chez Lyft, notre mission est de servir et de connecter. Nous y parvenons en favorisant un environnement de travail où chacun trouve sa place et a la possibilité de s'épanouir. Lyft Urban Solutions fournit les systèmes de vélos et de trottinettes en libre-service qui permettent à des millions de personnes de se déplacer dans plus de 60 villes à travers le monde. Nous avons créé le premier système de vélos en libre-service automatisé d'Amérique du Nord et restons à la pointe de la révolution de la micromobilité. Nos systèmes sont présents partout dans le monde : de Citi Bike à New York à BIXI à Montréal, en passant par Divvy à Chicago, Capital Bikeshare à Washington D.C., et des systèmes emblématiques à Austin, Barcelone, Bogota, Boston, Buenos Aires, Columbus, Détroit, Dubaï, Londres, Madrid, Mexico, Monaco, Pittsburgh, Portland, Rio de Janeiro, San Francisco, Toronto et bien d'autres villes. Nous ne sommes pas de simples fournisseurs de technologies : nous exploitons ces systèmes, en développant les logiciels, le matériel et les opérations qui permettent à la micromobilité urbaine de fonctionner à grande échelle. L'équipe de Lyft Urban Solutions à Montréal est en pleine croissance, et nous recherchons un(e) Analyste en planification des actifs. Ce rôle soutiendra la planification et l'allocation des pièces de rechange dans tous les marchés de micromobilité où Lyft est présente. We’re looking for an intellectually curious individual who has extraordinary attention to detail, a track record of analytical problem-solving and skilled communication. jobs.description_text: The Luxury team builds rich and creative features that set the standard for premium ground transportation. We’re looking for a motivated mid-career Android mobile engineer to build app experiences, UIs, and infrastructure for Black, Black SUV, and other upmarket modes in the Lyft app, as well as Alcove , Lyft’s new global chauffeur network. Alcove brings high-touch service to corporate travel programs and their passengers, handling everything from VIP travel to large events and multi-vehicle trips. Across all of it, quality is uncompromising. We work on balancing and growing these unique marketplaces and influencing driver and chauffeur behavior to facilitate the highest-quality rides. You'll collaborate with engineering, product, data science, analytics, and operations teams across Lyft and Alcove on programs that empower us to iterate quickly, delighting our passengers, bookers, drivers, and chauffeurs. Today, our pioneering micromobility system is operational in more than 50 cities worldwide, including Barcelona, Bogota, London, Madrid, Mexico City, Montreal, New York, and Rio de Janeiro, to name just a few. Join us and be part of the team behind some of the world's largest and most successful bike-share systems! Lyft's team in Montreal is growing, and we are seeking an Asset Planning Analyst to support spare parts planning and allocation for every micromobility market Lyft operates. You will make sure the right repair parts reach the right markets at the right time, so bikes and scooters stay on the street and riders can count on them. You are an analytical thinker who is excited about building scalable processes. You build forecasts that hold up to scrutiny, then turn them into long term solutions that work on the ground. You are as comfortable building the model as you are aligning a room of market leaders on it. jobs.description_text: The Bid Coordinator is the organizational backbone of the bid team. Working alongside Bid Managers and Bid Specialists, this role makes sure every bid runs to a rigorous, well-managed process, so that deadlines are met, contributors know what is expected of them, and nothing falls through the cracks. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive: someone who enjoys building order out of complexity, keeps many moving parts on track at once, and is comfortable following up with colleagues across the business to keep work moving. It is a strong entry point for someone looking to grow a career in bid management. Responsibilities: Bid Planning and Scheduling Support Support Bid Managers in building bid plans that work backward from the submission date, including milestones, review gates, internal deadlines, and buffer time. Set up and maintain bid trackers, schedules, and responsibility matrices (e.g., RACI) for each pursuit. Keep plans up to date as timelines shift, and flag schedule risks to the Bid Manager early. jobs.title: Data Curation Associate
jobs.description_text: At Lyft, we are building a more connected world, ride by ride. Whether it's an everyday commute or a journey that changes everything, we are driven by our purpose: to serve and connect. To create the best ride for all, we start in our own community by creating an open, inclusive, and diverse organization where all team members are recognized for their input. Data Curation Operations is a team which supports all ongoing curation projects for Mapping and other teams at Lyft. Our mission is to improve customer experience in Lyft products by providing high-quality, comprehensive, and efficient data curation operations. As a Data Curation Associate at Lyft, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the accuracy, quality, and usability of Map Data. You will work closely with various teams to curate and maintain data sets that are essential for our operations and decision-making processes. We are looking for someone who has good analytical skills and is able to work with a large amount of information. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit, like to solve challenging problems, and want to be part of the next big thing at Lyft, we would love to meet you! Responsibilities: Curate data sets, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and completeness. Document data and tooling issues meticulously for analysis. Create and maintain comprehensive project documentation. Accountability: Perform assigned tasks according to allocation, taking responsibility for assigned workload, expectations and timelines

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Decisions - Mapping
jobs.description_text: As a Data Scientist on the Mapping team, you will collaborate with our world class team of engineers, product managers, and designers to grow and improve the quality of recommended routes and accuracy of our travel time estimations. We're looking for a passionate, driven Data Scientist who is excited to dive into our spatial data and build a best-in-class mapping product that provides safe, efficient, and seamless navigation for our rideshare drivers. Data Science is at the heart of Lyft’s products and decision-making. You will leverage data and rigorous, analytical thinking to shape our mapping products and make business decisions that put our customers first. This will involve identifying and scoping opportunities, shaping priorities, recommending technical solutions, designing experiments, and measuring the impact of new features. You will help us solve some of the most impactful problems in mapping, including: How do we improve the quality of our map data in order to improve our recommendations? How do we benchmark and measure the success of our services? How do we validate features of the real world that affect our routing algorithms? Are we meeting our travel estimation promises to our customers? Responsibilities: Leverage data and analytic frameworks to identify opportunities for growth and efficiency Partner with product managers, engineers, and operators to translate analytical insights into decisions and action, and implement products to drive business goals Design

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Position for Xsolla's Smart Wallet in Web3
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who has tested real on-chain products — the contracts and the transactions, not only the web app in front of them. You will own quality for Xsolla's smart wallet on Xsolla ZK , our Ethereum-compatible ZK rollup: the wallet players use to hold, receive and send tokens and in-game items, signing in with the account they already have. The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You will fork the chain to test against real state, deploy and call contracts from the command line, and turn what you learn into automated suites. You will work in a small, senior engineering team alongside an external wallet-infrastructure partner. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. AI coding tools are part of how you work every day, and you set them up so the rest of the team gets the same leverage.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next. These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide. This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job. The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next. We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

Je brengt de benodigde materialen en hulpmiddelen in kaart. Je ontwikkelt instructie- en toolboxmateriaal voor medewerkers. Je stelt een praktisch implementatieadvies op om LOTO binnen Nedlin verder te borgen. Wat bieden wij?
